name: Open Design — Open-Source Claude Design Alternative
hook: 104k stars for the open-source answer to Claude Design. Local-first and agent-agnostic — drives Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or Gemini as the design engine via a skills/, design-systems/, and plugins/ directory layout any coding agent can read. Desktop app on macOS and Windows; Docker option for teams. Positions itself as the first collaborative AI design agent workspace.

name: Taste Skill — Dial-Based Art Direction for Agents
hook: 103k stars for Leon Lin's (@lexnlin) design control skill. Replaces vague style adjectives with three numeric baselines — DESIGN_VARIANCE 8, MOTION_INTENSITY 6, VISUAL_DENSITY 4 — that you can override per-prompt. Ships sub-skills for minimalist, brutalist, image-to-code, and redesign-existing-projects. Measured style consistency across Claude Code and Codex sessions. MIT-licensed.

name: Diagram Design — Editorial HTML/SVG Diagram Skill
hook: 61k stars for Cathryn Lavery's diagram skill covering 38–42 editorial diagram types — architecture, sequence, ERD, flow, timelines, and more. Output is self-contained HTML and SVG with no Mermaid dependency. A live gallery at cathrynlavery.github.io/diagram-design previews every type. MIT-licensed; installs via plugin marketplace in one command.

name: OmniRoute — Multi-Provider AI Gateway
hook: 81k+ stars, Day 4 of trending. MIT-licensed AI gateway exposing one endpoint for 375 providers (150+ free) and 1,400+ models. Quota-aware auto-fallback switches transparently when a quota is hit. Slots into Claude Code as a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` — no client changes needed. `omniroute configure claude` writes the config interactively.
recurring_note: ↑ Day 4 — 81k+ stars, still the top cost-reduction gateway

name: RTK — Rust CLI Token Proxy for Shell Commands
hook: 85k+ stars, Day 4. CLI proxy that intercepts shell commands (git, npm, cargo, etc.) and compresses their verbose output before the coding agent reads it: filters noise, groups similar items, truncates redundant context, collapses repeated log lines. Works via Claude Code's Bash hook. Project claims 60–90% token reduction on common dev commands (`git log` keeps only hash/author/subject; `cargo test` shows only failures).

name: Claude Code v2.1.310 — Monitor Tool on Cloud Platforms
hook: v2.1.310 (Oct 23) ships the Monitor tool and plugin monitors on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry — cloud-hosted Claude Code sessions can now watch background jobs without a local terminal. Also fixes gateway compatibility for orgs using strict API proxies. Follows v2.1.309 (Oct 22, 62 bug fixes), v2.1.307 (Oct 21, new `claude_code.safety_event` OpenTelemetry attribute + `@claude review stop`), and v2.1.304 (Oct 19, `/auto-mode-setup` guided onboarding).

name: claude-mem — Persistent Session Memory
hook: 103k+ stars, Day 4. Lifecycle hooks (SessionStart through SessionEnd) capture every tool call, compress observations into semantic summaries, and store them in SQLite + Chroma. Future sessions retrieve relevant context via hybrid semantic/keyword search — the project claims 10x token savings vs re-reading raw context. Works across Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and OpenClaw.

name: Agent Reach — Login-Walled Platform Access for Agents
hook: 103k+ stars, Day 4. CLI that unlocks content agents normally can't reach: login-walled platforms, video subtitles, Chinese platforms (Bilibili, XiaoHongShu), GitHub structured data — with zero API fees. Read-only by design (searches and reads, never posts). Installs via a skill reference file for Claude Code.

name: Archify — Idea-to-Interactive-Diagram Skill
hook: 89.7k+ stars, Day 4. Claude Code skill that turns a plain-language description or existing codebase into a self-contained, interactive HTML diagram — architecture, workflow, sequence, ERD, and others. The output opens in any browser without Archify installed; diagram nodes link back to source code. Latest stable v3.2.0.

name: Understand Anything — Semantic Code Knowledge Graph
hook: 88k+ stars, Day 3. Multi-agent pipeline maps files, functions, classes, and dependencies into an interactive knowledge graph with guided tours, diff impact analysis, and business-domain views. Installs as a Claude Code plugin; Cursor and VS Code + Copilot auto-discover it on clone.

name: Oh My OpenAgent — Multi-Agent Orchestration Layer
hook: 70.4k stars for the agent orchestration layer built on OpenCode. Keyword-triggered and vendor-lock-in-free — the Sisyphus orchestrator breaks complex requests into TODO lists and milestones, delegates to specialized subagents, and monitors progress to completion. Supports Claude Code, Codex, and other coding assistants without forcing a switch.

name: Marketing Skills — CRO, Copy, SEO & Analytics
